title: Simple Turret Block
description: A simple turret block that can use bow enchantments and uses different fuel sources to work
body:
# Turret Block

This mod was a mod request via Willfurr's Series

A Mod that adds an automated, placeable turret block that defends your base against mobs — or players.

## Features

### Automated Defense
Place a turret and it will automatically detect and shoot hostile mobs within range. The turret uses line-of-sight raycasting, so placement matters — walls will block targeting.

### Seven Targeting Modes
Cycle through targeting modes via the turret GUI:
- **All Hostile** (default) — targets any hostile mob
- **Zombies / Skeletons / Creepers / Spiders** 
- **All Mobs** — any living entity except players
- **Players** — all players except the turret's owner 

### Fuel System
Turrets require fuel to operate, using a familiar furnace-style system:

| Fuel | Burn Time | Bonus |
|------|-----------|-------|
| Coal / Charcoal | 1600 ticks | — |
| Blaze Rod | 2400 ticks | Faster fire rate |
| Blaze Powder | 1200 ticks | — |
| Gunpowder | 800 ticks | — |

### Enchantment Books
Slot up to 3 enchanted books into the turret to enhance its arrows:
- **Power**
- **Flame**
- **Punch**
- **Infinity** — still requires at least 1 arrow

Each active enchantment produces animated spiral particles around the turret.

### Soul Torch Range Boost
Place soul torches or soul lanterns within 8 blocks of the turret to extend its range. Each torch adds +5 blocks (base 20, max 40 with 4 torches). Connected torches create a visible particle funnel effect flowing into the turret.

## Crafting Recipe

```
 I B I
 I D I
 I R I
```

| Key | Item |
|-----|------|
| I | Iron Ingot |
| B | Bow |
| D | Dispenser |
| R | Redstone |
